divergence: Retained non-volatile packed-color candidate is 492 bytes with the retail 0x60 frame, exact stack slots, and all 17 relocation offsets/types/targets/addends equal, but canonical and function_reloc_diffs=all scores are 90.95935%, not a match. Persistent registers are actor/runtime/source/context/flags = r27/r28/r29/r30/r31 instead of retail r28/r29/r30/r31/r27. The second selected color uses r5 instead of r7. Direct ELF comparison finds 53 differing instruction words.
